mapper.select: select user_id, user_name, password, password_initialized, openid, status, phone_country_code, phone_hash, phone_masked, phone_bound_time, create_time, update_time from sys_user where user_name = #{userName}

select user_id, user_name, password, password_initialized, openid, status, phone_country_code, phone_hash, phone_masked, phone_bound_time, create_time, update_time from sys_user where openid = #{openid}

select user_id, user_name, password, password_initialized, openid, status, phone_country_code, phone_hash, phone_masked, phone_bound_time, create_time, update_time from sys_user where phone_hash = #{phoneHash}

select user_id, user_name, password, password_initialized, openid, status, phone_country_code, phone_hash, phone_masked, phone_bound_time, create_time, update_time from sys_user where phone_hash = #{phoneHash} for update

select user_id, user_name, password, password_initialized, openid, status, phone_country_code, phone_hash, phone_masked, phone_bound_time, create_time, update_time from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}

select user_id, user_name, password, password_initialized, openid, status, phone_country_code, phone_hash, phone_masked, phone_bound_time, create_time, update_time from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} for update
mapper.update: update sys_user set openid = #{openid}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and (openid is null or openid = '')
update sys_user set user_name = #{userName}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set password = #{password}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set password = #{password}, password_initialized = true, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set phone_country_code = #{phoneCountryCode}, phone_hash = #{phoneHash}, phone_masked = #{phoneMasked}, phone_bound_time = now(), update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
